title: EMM information procedure initiation by the network

entities.name: EMM information procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the network to send information to the UE during an established EMM context. It consists only of the EMM INFORMATION message.

entities.name: EMM INFORMATION
entities.description: A message sent from the network to the UE as part of the EMM information procedure. Multiple messages with potentially different content may be sent.

entities.name: Established EMM context
entities.description: A precondition for the EMM information procedure, indicating that the UE and network have an established EMM context.

entities.name: Multiple EMM INFORMATION messages possible
entities.description: The network may send none, one, or more EMM INFORMATION messages during an established EMM context, and messages need not have the same content.

relations.description: The EMM information procedure consists of sending the EMM INFORMATION message.
The EMM information procedure is performed during an established EMM context.
The procedure allows for sending none, one, or more EMM INFORMATION messages with potentially different content.
